name: Fun Time Original Water-Based Lubricant | 75ml | UK
description:
Fun Time Original Stimulating Lube – 75ml 

Enhance your intimate moments with Fun Time Original Stimulating Lube, specially formulated to stimulate and ease pleasure for both partners.

🔹 Silky Smooth: Non-sticky and non-greasy for ultimate comfort and sensation.
🔹 Fragrance-Free: Original flavor formula for a natural, enjoyable experience.
🔹 Water-Based & Safe: Compatible with condoms and sex toys.
🔹 Convenient Design: Easy-to-use pump bottle for quick and controlled application.
🔹 Size: 75ml – perfect for home or travel.

Ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Citric Acid

Usage Instructions: Twist the pump to open and apply to intimate areas. Reapply as needed.

Warnings: Avoid contact with eyes and broken skin. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.
